title: La Prueba de la Sobremesa, MEXITV
comment: prueba-penjamo (MEXITV): portal de piedra de la casa de un rancho ganadero en Pénjamo, Guanajuato, por la tarde. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.EVODIO_SALCEDO: Mexican man, powerful and feared cattle rancher, 68 years old, tanned weathered skin, thick white hair combed back, a full white mustache, heavy eyebrows, piercing dark eyes, a dark-brown suede jacket over a white shirt buttoned to the collar, a silver belt buckle, a cream felt cowboy hat resting on the table beside him, his hands empty.
chars.SAUL_SALCEDO: Mexican man, resentful eldest son of the rancher, 41 years old, light-brown skin, short black hair with grey at the temples, clean-shaven, a tense square jaw, narrow eyes, a navy-blue quilted vest over a light-blue checkered shirt, jeans, his hands empty.
chars.GERONIMO_SALCEDO: Mexican man, the rancher's favorite younger son, 32 years old, olive skin, wavy dark-brown hair, a short trimmed beard, warm green-brown eyes, a beige linen shirt with rolled sleeves, a thin leather bracelet, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_PORTALPENJAMO: Wide stone porch of an old cattle ranch house in Penjamo, Guanajuato, in the late golden afternoon: thick stone arches with magenta bougainvillea, a long rustic wooden table with a woven runner, clay plates with leftovers of a family meal, a clay jug and glasses, wooden chairs, dry hills and mesquite trees in the distance, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
